verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents a built-in AI Assistant that can read threads, write drafts, search your full email history and check your calendar. Through AI Integrations and MCP it can also run complex workflows across connected apps without leaving the inbox, and triggers can draft replies automatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks work as claimed, and documentation of multi-step task execution and approval controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
